title: Tygart Lake State Park Beach & Bathhouse
overview: The beach was an algae-prone concrete slab with ill-defined paths. MEI developed an overall plan and renovated the beach and access, volleyball, horseshoe, and grilling areas, and the bathhouse — new piping, electrical, lighting, HVAC, and ADA-compliant fixtures — with a code-compliant kitchen upgrade and added capacity for a future concession stand.
